text: Need a better way to handle jotting quick working-memory notes without building a cluttered backlog, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord?
Watch Focus Note in action: Notes automatically clear 24 hours after your last edit—eliminating stale clutter and giving your brain a fresh, guilt-free surface every day.

No login walls, no folder trees, and no formatting toolbars. Open the side panel, paste a phone number or thought, and stay in your flow. Plus, wrote something worth keeping permanently? Copy it to your clipboard or download a clean plain-text file to your computer in a single click.
Whatever you type—confirmation codes, rough drafts, or private thoughts—never leaves your device or touches a cloud server.
Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
